ffn.note: estimand_mean_of_seed_nse/rmse are the arithmetic mean of each seed's own, independently computed metric over its full pooled (across years/folds) 49,478-hour common-support series -- this is what the manuscript reports. NOT an ensemble metric (median-prediction-then-score). The concat_seeds_rmse field is a different, NOT manuscript-reported quantity, included only to make the distinction between 'mean of per-seed RMSE' and 'RMSE on all seeds' rows pooled together' explicit and inspectable.
